FN-3547EZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 52
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 52 as introduced would expand the Alabama Safe at Schools Act to include the
training of certain school personnel to administrate medication to students with an adrenal
insufficiency no later than the beginning of the 2024-2025 school year.
The provisions of this bill would increase the obligations of: (1) the State Department of
Education and the Alabama Board of Nursing to develop guidance for the training of certain
school personnel with regards to the medical needs of students with an adrenal insufficiency; (2)
all local boards of education for the additional training of school nurses and unlicensed
medication assistants; and (3) all public schools to provide for personnel trained in the care to
students with an adrenal insufficiency for various school activities.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 52
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 52 as passed the Senate would expand the Alabama Safe at Schools Act to include
the training of certain school personnel to administrate medication to students with an adrenal
insufficiency no later than the beginning of the 2024-2025 school year.
The provisions of this bill would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the State
Department of Education and the Alabama Board of Nursing to develop guidance for the
training of certain school personnel with regards to the medical needs of students with an
adrenal insufficiency; (2) all local boards of education for the additional training of school
nurses and unlicensed medication assistants; and (3) all public schools to provide personnel
trained in the care to students with an adrenal insufficiency for various school
activities.
